summary: Helpdesk and ticketing software from Freshworks for email, chat, phone and social support.
access_note: API key from profile settings, sent as HTTP Basic (key as username, X as password). Free trial only; MCP needs Growth plan or above.
blocker_note: Trial only; official MCP is gated to Growth/Pro/Enterprise with monthly action allowances.
notes: MCP endpoint pattern and plan limits (Growth 1,200 actions/yr) read directly from the Freshworks partner-support article. OAuth for the REST API is inferred from per-endpoint OAuth scopes in the API reference; the OAuth app setup flow was not read, so oauth2 is listed second.

evidence.quote: Your API key will be available below the change password section to your right

review.reason: API reference shows an OAuth 2.0 scope on each endpoint (e.g. freshdesk.tickets.create), so OAuth exists beside the API key; MCP is API-key only.
